scope: Direct blocking/finding producers and shared evidence/normalization helpers in the declared production modules; nested checks fingerprinted within owning functions. External model judgement and host capability remain runtime obligations.

source.authority: Approved Source-of-Truth schema, branch requirements and clinical relationships
source.false_rejection_risk: Alias or source-shape differences; mixed enrollment/endpoint text needs source review before generation
source.duplicate_policy: source_contract owns normalization before approval; clinical evidence remains immutable

authority_contract.requirement: Approved Source-of-Truth schema, branch requirements and clinical relationships
authority_contract.evidence: Approved Source-of-Truth schema, branch requirements and clinical relationships

evidence.authority: SectionSpec evidence/ownership and shared section_evidence_value; semantic hypothesis contract
evidence.false_rejection_risk: Lexical overlap is a heuristic; structural IDs, bibliography and binary cells must be excluded by the shared projection
evidence.duplicate_policy: Drafting, Protocol rendered fidelity and Sterling consume shared section projections; endpoint inventory stays in its Study Design owner. Independent review still assesses meaning/relations.
evidence.coverage: test_evidence_variations.py; test_evidence_diagnostics.py; test_assessment_matrix.py; test_hypothesis_fidelity.py; test_visit_identifier_scope.py; test_section_background_scope.py; test_semantic_evidence_recovery.py; test_concept_reference_grounding.py; test_review_resolutions.py; test_clean_delivery.py

authority_contract.requirement: Approved facts and citations must be retained; lexical overlap and narrative repetition are uncertainty, not proof of absence.
authority_contract.evidence: SectionSpec evidence/ownership and shared section_evidence_value; semantic hypothesis contract

clinical.authority: Approved values plus Brad section ownership and governed template clauses
clinical.false_rejection_risk: Overbroad keyword rules or contradictory draft/render scopes; do not promote heuristic success into clinical approval
clinical.duplicate_policy: Shared evidence scope for sourced prose; exact legal text and placement retain separate authority
clinical.coverage: test_sterling_rendered_scope.py; test_phase2_sterling_fidelity.py; test_brad_editorial_feedback.py; test_sterling_template_comments.py; test_review_resolutions.py; test_clean_delivery.py

authority_contract.requirement: Approved values plus Brad section ownership and governed template clauses
authority_contract.evidence: Approved values plus Brad section ownership and governed template clauses

structured.authority: Approved enrollment total, cohorts/interventions, endpoints, visits and PRS schema
structured.false_rejection_risk: Dropping keys or guessing first numbers can destroy relationships; ambiguous matrix cells must not be guessed
structured.duplicate_policy: contracts normalizes visit interpretation; table and narrative project that interpretation. PRS generation/validation share mapping helpers; independently asserted expected values in regression tests and full independent content review provide additional protection.
structured.coverage: test_assessment_matrix.py; test_prs_quality_corrections.py; test_prs_xml.py; test_bilateral_review_block.py; test_mixed_visit_representations.py; test_review_resolutions.py; test_clean_delivery.py

authority_contract.requirement: Approved enrollment total, cohorts/interventions, endpoints, visits and PRS schema
authority_contract.evidence: Approved enrollment total, cohorts/interventions, endpoints, visits and PRS schema

render.authority: Exact template topology, DOCX/PDF/page images and release-owned renderer
render.false_rejection_risk: Host environment, font capability, page splitting or sparse page classifications; host smoke does not certify every layout
render.duplicate_policy: Render defects route to layout/construction owner; complete fresh exact-artifact review follows repair
render.coverage: test_duration_reference_preservation.py; test_handoff_quality.py; host installation render smoke; test_review_resolutions.py; test_clean_delivery.py

authority_contract.requirement: Exact template topology, DOCX/PDF/page images and release-owned renderer
authority_contract.evidence: Exact template topology, DOCX/PDF/page images and release-owned renderer

review.authority: Authenticated independent reviewer identity, complete source and artifact scope, exact hashes
review.false_rejection_risk: Malformed responses or targets can look like content defects; transport and semantic findings need different routes
review.duplicate_policy: Exact authenticated requests and source-grounded uncertainty resolutions share the canonical ledger. Confirmed prose/editorial defects require correction; only meaningful remaining external limitations accompany delivery. Objective failures cannot be waived.
review.coverage: test_handoff_quality.py; test_visit_inventory_review.py; test_hypothesis_fidelity.py; test_editorial_publication.py; test_phase1_repetition.py; test_review_resolutions.py; test_clean_delivery.py

authority_contract.requirement: Authenticated independent reviewer identity, complete source and artifact scope, exact hashes
authority_contract.evidence: Authenticated independent reviewer identity, complete source and artifact scope, exact hashes

recovery.authority: Persisted deadline, distinct completed attempts, recovery ownership and gate ledger
recovery.false_rejection_risk: Counting the same response repeatedly; generic diagnostics produce identical retries; transport retry must not consume drafting streak
recovery.duplicate_policy: workflow owns retry state/deadlines; code-owned sections use native rendered snapshots when no accepted AI draft exists. Progress requires changed target and candidate; a fresh full review still decides correctness.

authority_contract.requirement: Persisted deadline, distinct completed attempts, recovery ownership and gate ledger
authority_contract.evidence: Persisted deadline, distinct completed attempts, recovery ownership and gate ledger

installation.authority: Package manifest, installation/runtime integrity, exact worker profile and optional certification mode
installation.false_rejection_risk: API-key profile mistaken for subscription; unsigned ordinary generation accidentally subjected to signed certification
installation.duplicate_policy: Installation owns provisioning/smoke; ordinary manual review does not require certification; developer offline check is not activation preflight
installation.coverage: test_worker_readiness.py; exact host installation integrity/render smoke; optional certification deliberately excluded; test_review_resolutions.py; test_clean_delivery.py

authority_contract.requirement: Package manifest, installation/runtime integrity, exact worker profile and optional certification mode
authority_contract.evidence: Package manifest, installation/runtime integrity, exact worker profile and optional certification mode

delivery.authority: Final complete accepted review, atomic publication and exact client bytes
delivery.false_rejection_risk: Transient attachment access must retry the same bytes within the original deadline
delivery.duplicate_policy: One final artifact identity; client output never substitutes an unapproved candidate

authority_contract.requirement: Final complete accepted review, atomic publication and exact client bytes
authority_contract.evidence: Final complete accepted review, atomic publication and exact client bytes

source_routing.authority: Source-quoted display interpretation and independent raw-source-to-destination review
source_routing.false_rejection_risk: Optional omissions or legitimate paraphrases must not become word-match vetoes or extra source questions
source_routing.duplicate_policy: Hermes owns meaning; contracts constrain source quotations and identity; review audits raw source independently; approval bytes remain immutable

authority_contract.requirement: Preserve explicit visit relationships and applicable qualified benefits on their intended document surfaces
authority_contract.evidence: Exact approved-source quotations, existing visit identities, current artifact passages and authenticated independent review

presentation_delivery.authority: Authenticated independent review with five explicit false harm assessments; known presentation checks only
presentation_delivery.false_rejection_risk: Optional wording improvements and synonymous reviewer surface labels must not veto otherwise verified complete delivery
presentation_delivery.duplicate_policy: Shared presentation disposition owns classification; positive renderer provenance owns optional single-passage polish; final exact-artifact review remains mandatory

authority_contract.requirement: Complete clean delivery with harmless presentation observations retained internally; material, integrity and incomplete-review failures remain blocking
authority_contract.evidence: Authenticated exact reviewer response, explicit harm assessments, generated passage provenance, current complete content and page reviews

source_bound_construction.authority: Authenticated archived candidate and immutable scoped approved evidence; independent final review
source_bound_construction.false_rejection_risk: Ambiguous native locations and unsupported scalar transformations require independent localization; valid scalar edits do not imply semantic approval
source_bound_construction.duplicate_policy: Shared constrained construction handoff; native field identity bounds overlapping retries and chronological replay

authority_contract.evidence: Exact archived candidate hashes, registered native locations, scoped approved scalars and authenticated producer response
